Class AdventureTourPackage

java.lang.Object
TourPackage
AdventureTourPackage
public class AdventureTourPackage extends TourPackage
Represents an adventure tour package that extends the base TourPackage. Demonstrates Single Inheritance in the Tourism domain.

An adventure tour adds attributes such as activity type, difficulty level and mandatory insurance to the basic tour package.

    • calculateCost

      public double calculateCost()
      Calculates the total cost including a risk premium based on difficulty level.
      • Easy — no premium
      • Moderate — 15% premium
      • Difficult — 30% premium
      An additional Rs. 2000 is charged if insurance is mandatory.
      Overrides:
      calculateCost in class TourPackage
      Returns:
      the total calculated cost
